title: Concrete Root-Uptake Crop-State Provider Readiness
purpose: Determine whether a source-bound concrete provider can expose the current crop state required by F-WOF11 at the physically correct evaluation point without importing legacy globals, daily driver assumptions or runtime dependencies into crop physics.
legacy_source_questions: where and when fl_cropemergence becomes authoritative
where and when ptra is computed relative to root extraction
where and when noddrz is updated relative to root-depth growth
where and when cumdens_top is recomputed relative to root extraction
whether these four values are all current at one well-defined process evaluation point
whether their validity depends on flDayStart, one-call-per-day or another hidden driver cadence
whether provider extraction can be state/forcing based rather than direct module-global reads

readiness_gates.G1_owner_contract: F-WOF11 and target architecture keep crop semantics outside runtime
readiness_gates.G2_current_state_point: prove a single source-bound evaluation point where all four provider values are current
readiness_gates.G3_time_semantics: separate genuine crop calendar/day physics from accidental legacy driver cadence
readiness_gates.G4_transactional_semantics: provider must read trial-consistent crop/ET state and must not mutate committed state
readiness_gates.G5_no_legacy_global_dependency: production provider may not expose MOD_meteo/MOD_cropdevelopment/plant_interface globals directly
readiness_gates.G6_no_runtime_dependency_in_crop: crop provider implementation may implement F-WOF11 but may not use F-MR modules
readiness_gates.G7_optional_state: inactive crop must not require allocation of root-distribution state
readiness_gates.G8_smallest_seam: identify the minimum new crop-state/ET contract needed; do not migrate full WOFOST implicitly

fail_closed_policy.if_only_legacy_global_reads_can_supply_v: BLOCK and hand off to crop-host state owner
fail_closed_policy.if_hidden_daily_cadence_is_required: qualify only that cadence explicitly; do not generalize to arbitrary [t0,t1]

required_outputs: smallest admitted next seam or fail-closed blocker
